description: We are a team of curious, creative, and enthusiastic students who love science, technology, coding, gaming, and exploring new ideas. We enjoy solving problems, designing, experimenting, and learning new skills. Each of us has different talents and interests, which makes our team unique. We love working together, sharing ideas, helping each other, and having fun while learning. Our biggest strengths are teamwork, imagination, determination, and our passion for discovering new things!
summary:
Lunar Legends is an interactive 3D space survival game designed to challenge players to think like real astronauts. Set on a simulated Moon base, the game places players in charge of making important decisions that affect the survival and success of their crew.

Throughout the mission, players face realistic space exploration challenges, including limited resources, equipment management, and unexpected emergencies. They must make smart decisions to keep the lunar base functioning and protect the astronauts. When a solar radiation storm threatens the base, players must respond quickly and move the crew to safety.

Lunar Legends:

Inspired by NASA's Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer challenge, our project transforms the complexities of lunar exploration into an engaging, hands-on learning experience.

Lunar Legends demonstrates that surviving and working on the Moon requires more than technology. It takes teamwork, careful planning, scientific thinking, and the ability to make difficult decisions under pressure. Every choice matters, and one decision can affect the entire mission.
details:
Project Details – Lunar Legends: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer

How Does Our Project Work?

Lunar Legends is a computer-based interactive 3D simulation that allows players to experience the responsibilities of managing a lunar base. Players control an astronaut and interact with different objects and systems throughout the environment. Using CoBlocks programming, we created interactive features, movement controls, and resource-monitoring systems. Status bars display the astronaut's energy, oxygen, and other essential resources. As players make decisions and perform actions, resource levels change, creating challenges that require careful planning.

Benefits of Our Project

Our project provides an educational way for students to explore the challenges of living on the Moon. It encourages critical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, teamwork, and responsible decision-making. It also introduces students to space technology, resource management, and the importance of astronaut safety.

Intended Impact

Our goal is to make learning about space exploration more interactive, exciting, and accessible to young students. We want players to understand that even small decisions can have major consequences during a space mission. By experiencing these challenges in a simulated environment, students can develop skills that are important for future scientists, engineers, and astronauts.

Tools and Technology Used

We developed our project using:

  • Delightex Nova: Used to build the interactive 3D lunar environment.
  • CoBlocks: Used for visual programming, character movement, interactions, and resource systems.
  • 3D Objects and Characters: Used to create the astronaut, lunar base, and mission equipment.
  • Variables: Used to track and update resource levels.
  • Interactive Status Bars: Used to visually display the astronaut's available resources.

Creativity and Innovation

What makes Lunar Legends creative is that it transforms real-world space exploration challenges into an interactive game. Rather than simply explaining how astronauts manage resources, our project allows players to experience these responsibilities themselves. The combination of a 3D environment, interactive coding, character controls, and changing resource levels makes the learning experience more engaging.

Factors Our Team Considered

While developing our project, we considered several important factors:

  • Realism: Making the challenges reflect actual conditions astronauts may face on the Moon.
  • Astronaut Safety: Including emergencies and protective shelters.
  • Resource Management: Showing how oxygen, food, water, and electricity are essential for survival.
  • User Experience: Making the controls and instructions understandable for young players.
  • Educational Value: Ensuring that players learn scientific concepts while having fun.
  • Creativity: Designing an original and engaging experience that encourages exploration and problem-solving.

Our ultimate goal is to combine science, technology, and creativity to help the next generation understand the challenges of living and working beyond Earth.
